notes.title: Up to 20% off on Bridge Constructor: The Walking Dead with the loyalty discount!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5213421/e584f20a8bc22cc9ab4afae414747270bedd92d6.jpg[/img]

Dear constructors and engineers,

just a few days to go till the launch of our latest instalment of our [b]Bridge Constructor[/b] franchise; [b]Bridge Constructor: The Walking Dead[/b]! The game’s pre-order also comes at a 10% discount - and by the way; till November 26th there will be an additional special 10% loyalty discount available on the game if you own at least one of the already released [b]Bridge Constructor[/b] games.

Means you can save up to 20% on [b]Bridge Constructor: The Walking Dead[/b] if you own just one of the following games:
[list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/250460/Bridge_Constructor]Bridge Constructor[/url]
